Don't show this message again Close Print +1.3% and +1.5% respectively compared with the third quarter of 2025 Overview In the third quarter of 2026, seasonally adjusted GDP increased by 0.4% in the euro area and by 0.5% in the EU , compared with the previous quarter, according to a preliminary flash estimate published by Eurostat, the statistical office of the European Union . In the second quarter of 2026, GDP had increased by 0.6% in the euro area and by 0.7% in the EU . These preliminary GDP flash estimates are based on data sources that are incomplete and subject to further revisions. Compared with the same quarter of the previous year, seasonally adjusted GDP increased by 1.3% in the euro area and by 1.5% in the EU in the third quarter of 2026, after +1.2% in the euro area and +1.4% in the EU in the previous quarter. Among the Member States for which data are available for the third quarter of 2026, Ireland (+5.5%) recorded the highest increase compared to the previous quarter, followed by Estonia , Spain and Netherlands (all +0.6%). Declines were recorded in Lithuania (-1.0%) and France (-0.1%). The year-on-year growth rate was positive for fourteen countries and negative for one country. Don't show this message again Close Print EU at 6.2% Overview In September 2026, the euro area seasonally adjusted unemployment rate was 6.5%, stable compared with August 2026 and up from 6.3% in September 2025. The EU unemployment rate was 6.2% in September 2026, also stable compared with August 2026 and up from 6.0% in September 2025. These figures are published by Eurostat, the statistical office of the European Union . Eurostat estimates that 13.773 million persons in the EU , of whom 11.555 million in the euro area , were unemployed in September 2026. Compared with August 2026, unemployment increased by 105 thousand in the EU and by 122 thousand in the euro area . Compared with September 2025, unemployment increased by 471 thousand in the EU and by 420 thousand in the euro area . Youth unemployment In September 2026, 3.022 million young persons (under 25) were unemployed in the EU , of whom 2.469 million were in the euro area . In September 2026, the youth unemployment rate was 15.5% in the EU , up from 15.4% in the previous month, and 15.4% in the euro area , also up from 15.1% in August 2026. Compared with August 2026, youth unemployment increased by 44 thousand in the EU and by 69 thousand in the euro area . Compared with September 2025, youth unemployment increased by 45 thousand in the EU and by 80 thousand in the euro area . Unemployment by sex In September 2026, the unemployment rate for women was 6.4% in the EU and the unemployment rate for men was 6.0%, both stable compared with the previous month. In the euro area , the unemployment rate for women was 6.7%, stable compared with August 2026, and the unemployment rate for men was 6.4%, up from 6.3% in the previous month.
